headline: Tuesday 15-game slate — no confirmed under edges, pass
body: Scanning all 30 named Tuesday starters for a CONFIRMED short-outing reason (announced pitch/inning cap, opener/bullpen game, or IL/TJ build-up), nothing qualifies today. No openers are scheduled on the slate and every arm projects to its normal role. The softest, non-actionable notes: Jake Bennett (BOS @ ATH) — post-TJ rookie whose season workload the Red Sox are monitoring, but they've said they'll keep running him out full (no per-start cap); Logan Henderson (MIL @ SF) — rookie still building up on ~76-85 pitches but no cited cap; Griffin Jax (TBR) — converted reliever now a stretched-out full starter (5 IP, 6 K on 7/17), his opener role is over; plus rookies Gage Jump, Troy Melton, Hunter Dobbins and Zac Thornton, all pitching to roughly their normal ~5 IP with no announced cap. None has a hard, cited short-outing reason, so all defer to the market. Verdict: no plays. Tendencies, not guarantees — verify starters at first pitch, flat small units, never chase.
